prompt: I'm starting a Marketplace flipping side hustle on top of a job and family. Set up a full GTD system for it: lists, contexts, a sample project with natural planning, and a Weekly Review checklist.
assertions: Sets up the list categories (projects, next actions, waiting for, calendar, someday/maybe, reference)
Runs natural planning on a project (purpose, outcome, brainstorm, organize, next actions)
Gives a Weekly Review checklist (get clear, get current, get creative)
Applies the two-minute rule and/or clarifying questions
